title: Zoho Books Credit Note: Refund vs Apply to Invoice (5 Mistakes)
description:
Zoho Books credit note: should you refund the customer or apply it to an invoice? This step-by-step video shows how to create a credit note (from an invoice or from Sales › Credit Notes), how to apply it to invoices from the credit note page or the invoice page, how to refund it, how to undo an applied credit, and the 5 mistakes to avoid. Amounts in the video are round examples only.

Chapters
0:00 Refund or apply, fast
0:41 Refund or apply?
1:31 Mistake 1: Starting from scratch
2:51 Mistake 2: Using the wrong path
3:54 Mistakes 3 and 4: Applying credits
5:27 Mistake 5: No undo plan
6:20 Your checklist

- Zoho Books help - Apply credits: https://www.zoho.com/us/books/help/credit-note/apply-credits.html
- Zoho Books help - Refund credits: https://www.zoho.com/us/books/help/credit-note/refund-credits.html
- Zoho Books KB - Issue a refund: https://www.zoho.com/us/books/kb/credits/issue-refund.html
